wording: - **The JAEG (health and care only):** an employee whose regular yearly pay exceeds EUR 77,400 is free of compulsory health insurance ([§ 6(1) no. 1 SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__6.html)). For someone already insured, cover ends at the end of the year the limit is exceeded, but only if the pay also exceeds next year's limit (§ 6(4)). The special JAEG of EUR 69,750 applies only to those privately insured on 31 December 2002 for that reason. Such an employee may stay voluntarily or go private; either way the employer pays a subsidy ([§ 257 SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__257.html)).

wording: - **Minijob and transition band:** pay up to EUR 603 a month is a Minijob ([§ 8(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__8.html)). Above that, up to EUR 2,000 a month, the employee's share is reduced ([§ 20(2) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__20.html)). Both are in `de-payroll`.

wording: - **Job plus business:** if self-employment is the main occupation, the job does not bring compulsory health insurance (§ 5(5) SGB V), but pension and unemployment insurance of the job continue. If the job is the main occupation, the employee is insured through it and the freelance income carries no health or care contribution: the contribution is on pay. The exception is an employee who also draws a statutory pension or a pension-like payment (Versorgungsbezüge): then the freelance income counts too, if it and any pension-like payments together exceed 1/20 of the monthly reference amount (EUR 197.75 in 2026) ([§ 226(1) no. 4 and (2) SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__226.html)). Employing someone above the Minijob level raises the presumption that self-employment is the main occupation; the fund decides case by case.

Pay exceeds EUR 77,400, so the employee is free of compulsory health insurance and may stay as a voluntary member or go private, with the employer's subsidy. Pension and unemployment continue at 9.3% and 1.3% on the full EUR 7,000: EUR 651.00 and EUR 91.00 from the employee. Payroll steps: `de-payroll`.

wording: - **Who decides.** The parties to a contract can ask the Deutsche Rentenversicherung Bund, in writing or electronically, whether it is employment or self-employment. This is not possible once a health fund or another insurer has already started its own procedure on the same contract ([§ 7a(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__7a.html)). The fund must apply where the employer's report shows that the worker is the employer's spouse, partner or descendant, or a managing shareholder of a GmbH. The decision rests on an overall assessment of all circumstances. Other insurers are bound by it.
classification: Operative selected official provisions; exact original-language quote, raw/reader identity and actual read date linked.

wording: - **The test.** Signs of employment are work under instructions and being part of the client's organisation ([§ 7(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__7.html)). Working for one client only is not by itself employment, but it can trigger compulsory pension insurance as a one-client self-employed person (group 9 above). Keep the two risks apart.
classification: Operative selected official provisions; exact original-language quote, raw/reader identity and actual read date linked.

wording: - **Before the work starts.** On application the decision can be made before the work begins (§ 7a(4a)). Changes in the first month must be reported at once. A client can also ask for an opinion that covers other contracts of the same kind (§ 7a(4b)). These options, the third-party rule of § 7a(2) sentences 2 and 3, and the right to a joint hearing expire at the end of 30 June 2027 (§ 7a(7)). Check the law for any contract running past that date.
classification: Operative selected official provisions; exact original-language quote, raw/reader identity and actual read date linked.

wording: - **The one-month window.** If the application is made within one month of the work starting and employment is found, insurance starts only on the day the decision is announced. Two conditions apply: the worker consents, and for the time in between the worker had cover against illness and for old age comparable to the statutory schemes. The total contribution then falls due only when the decision can no longer be challenged (§ 7a(5)).
classification: Operative selected official provisions; exact original-language quote, raw/reader identity and actual read date linked.

wording: - **Appeals.** An objection or court action against the decision has suspensive effect (§ 7a(6)).
classification: Operative selected official provisions; exact original-language quote, raw/reader identity and actual read date linked.

wording: - **If employment is found later**, without the one-month protection, the client owes contributions back to the start of the work, and late-payment surcharges of 1% a month on the rounded-down arrears can follow ([§ 24(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__24.html)). The exposure is large. Refer before the client signs or at once when it comes up.

**Example 1: self-employed consultant, middle income.** Profit EUR 48,000 in the latest tax notice (EUR 4,000 a month), voluntary member, no sick pay, childless, age 35, no single client. The base of EUR 4,000 lies between the minimum base and the ceiling. Health EUR 4,000 x (14.0% + 2.9%) = EUR 676.00. Care EUR 4,000 x 4.2% (childless) = EUR 168.00. Total EUR 844.00 a month. Not on the § 2 SGB VI list, so no pension duty; voluntary contributions are possible.

```oa-check
name: DE 2026 voluntary member, profit 48,000, childless, no sick pay
inputs:
  profit_year: 48000
  reference_month: 3955
  ceiling_month: 5812.50
  extra_rate: 2.9
steps:
  - min_base: reference_month / 3
  - base: clamp(profit_year / 12, min_base, ceiling_month)
  - health: round(base * (14.0 + extra_rate) / 100, 2)
  - care: round(base * 4.2 / 100, 2)
  - total: health + care
expected:
  base: 4000
  health: 676.00
  care: 168.00
  total: 844.00
```

wording:
**Example 2: yoga teacher in the first year, low income, one child.** Starts teaching on 1 March 2026, profit about EUR 1,000 a month, no insured staff, one child aged 10, voluntary health member without sick pay. Health: the base is lifted to the minimum of EUR 1,318.33, so health EUR 222.80 (check) and care at 3.6% EUR 47.46. Pension: a teacher with no insured staff is on the § 2 SGB VI list and EUR 1,000 is above the EUR 603 Minijob limit, so the work is not marginal. Register by the end of May 2026. In the start phase (to the end of 2029) the base is half the reference amount: EUR 1,977.50 x 18.6% = EUR 367.82 a month, or EUR 735.63 on application. Total EUR 638.08 a month on EUR 1,000 of profit, which is why the minimum bases matter.

```oa-check
name: DE 2026 yoga teacher start phase, profit 1,000 a month, one child
inputs:
  profit_month: 1000
  reference_month: 3955
  ceiling_month: 5812.50
  minijob: 603
  extra_rate: 2.9
steps:
  - min_base: reference_month / 3
  - base: clamp(profit_month, min_base, ceiling_month)
  - health: round(base * (14.0 + extra_rate) / 100, 2)
  - care: round(base * 3.6 / 100, 2)
  - above_marginal: max(0, profit_month - minijob)
  - pension: round(reference_month / 2 * 18.6 / 100, 2)
  - total: health + care + pension
expected:
  base: 1318.33
  health: 222.80
  care: 47.46
  above_marginal: 397
  pension: 367.82
  total: 638.08
```
